text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the suite hasn't been run. I checked each fix against its test by reading the code.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int. It was left as a string.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma` (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). I made up the author, year and copy count, since the tests only check the title.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events instead of `n+1`. It returns an empty list when `n` is 0 or negative.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, as the comment and tests say. It was 3.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. The old import pointed at a module that doesn't exist.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
